newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB extends gain after Kleinwort "buy".
newsitem.headline: BSkyB extends gain after Kleinwort "buy".

text.p: Shares in British Sky Broadcasting Plc were the biggest percentage gainers in a weak UK equity market by early afternoon Tuesday amid further reaction to a "buy" rating yesterday from Kleinwort Benson, dealers said.

The stock was up 12p or 2.14 percent at 573-1/2 by 1417 GMT, extending a rebound since it hit a five-month low of 473p on December 13. By contrast the FTSE 100 index was down 23.1 points at 4,170.9. Dealers said the market had been left short of stock after yesterday's Kleinwort comment, with analysts at the brokerage setting a price target of 700p on the shares.
"Kleinwort likes the stock and it is not a bad market today," said one dealer.
